items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Mister Young told me that... See, that's what we always called him.

ctx.x: A Victor, that's what it is. So I used to play it all the time. So then it got good. I kept blowing it, and I was getting pretty good on it. Then Mister Young told me... See, that's what we always called him. Mister Young told me that...
You were into the record before you knew Willis Young or after you knew Willis Young?
